name: TGI per-request inference-duration histogram
notes: TGI main, router/src/server.rs plus backends/v3/src/{backend,queue,lib}.rs, read 2026-10-04. On by default: the Prometheus recorder is built unconditionally with PrometheusBuilder and an HTTP listener on prometheus_port, default 9000, so nothing has to be opted into. Label keys are method (prefill|decode) on the batch families, err on tgi_request_failure, and reason on tgi_batch_concat - there are no model or engine labels, so every series is fleet-wide. inference_time = now - response.start. Includes prefill and decode together, which is why tgi_request_mean_time_per_token_duration inherits the prefill contamination.
